scope_guards: The current Planning Data page exposes no minimum or maximum dwelling capacity; no prior numeric value is silently copied into the current record.
The current Planning Data page exposes a blank end date; earlier website snapshot claims remain a source-version conflict rather than a current fact.
Permissioned status is not treated as commenced or completed development.
The brownfield-site multipolygon is Planning Data geography and not exact HMLR title topology.
Application 23/00182/NONMAT is linked to 16/01325/OUT and does not create additive dwelling capacity.
Extension of reserved-matters submission timescales is not proof that all reserved matters were approved or implemented.
CPO and Council freehold context are not exact current proprietor/title bindings for all land interests.
No score or promotion is written while capacity/current-status conflict, exact topology and overlays remain unresolved.
